main.description: Per-account vault metadata: key-derivation parameters and an encrypted verifier used to check a master password without decrypting any real vault item. Always stored at rkey 'self'. Contains no plaintext secrets.

kdf.description: Key-derivation function used to turn the master password into an encryption key.

salt.description: Base64-encoded random salt for the KDF, unique per account.

verifier.description: Base64-encoded AES-256-GCM encryption (iv + ciphertext + authTag) of a fixed known string under the derived vault key, used solely to detect an incorrect master password.
